run_embedding_api_base64: run the vLLM embedding API client with base64-encoded binary embedding responses
post_http_request_embeddings: post a base64-encoded embedding request to the vLLM API server and retrieve binary embeddings
parse_args_cli_config: parse command-line arguments for host and port to configure the vLLM API server connection
decode_base64_embeddings_tensor: decode base64-encoded embedding data into PyTorch tensors with configurable dtype and endianness
iterate_embedding_dtypes_endianness: iterate over all embedding dtypes and endianness combinations to test vLLM embedding output formats
